intent=i022 snapshot=s01 branch=header-accessor-no-linearize status=complete
coverage_gap=Only net/ and drivers/net/ .c files were grepped for the seven accessor names plus reset/set variants (964 hits in 260 files); files outside those directories (e.g. netfilter users in security/, fs/, or selftests) were not scanned.
coverage_gap=Roughly 230 files with only one or two accessor uses, mostly TX checksum/GSO code in ethernet drivers, were ranked but never opened; their receive-path subset is unreviewed.
coverage_gap=net/ipv6/ndisc.c (11 hits, variable-length ND options) and net/netfilter/nf_flow_table_ip.c (18 hits, offload decap) were name-triaged only and are recorded as unresolved candidates.
coverage_gap=net/openvswitch/flow.c, net/ipv6/mcast.c, net/ipv6/ip6_gre.c, net/ipv4/ip_tunnel_core.c, net/ipv6/seg6_iptunnel.c, net/xfrm/xfrm_iptfs.c and net/core/drop_monitor.c accessor users were never read.
coverage_gap=Whether any ieee802154/mac802154 hardware driver actually hands a non-linear (frag-backed) skb into ieee802154_rx_irqsafe/lowpan_rcv was assessed structurally, not by tracing each driver's skb allocation; this is the empirical precondition for both 802.154 findings.
coverage_gap=No runtime reproduction: the snapshot is read-only, no KASAN build, crafted non-linear frame, or C reproduction harness was produced (no compile attempted; conclusions rest on static reading of the exact supplied lines).
limitation=All findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions; unlike the phonet seed, none is a KASAN-confirmed slab-use-after-free, and the concrete failure modes are OOB reads past skb_headlen (6lowpan, llsec) rather than a stale-pointer read of a freed head.
limitation=The ipv6_srh_rcv finding is the weakest: the SRH bytes are guaranteed linear by the caller's double pskb_may_pull (exthdrs.c:660-666), and seg6_hmac_validate_skb in this tree performs no skb mutation, so the captured hdr (line 375) is currently re-derived correctly at line 441 and the defect is only the missing re-derivation across the validation call at 389; it is reported as a medium-confidence structural hypothesis, and a future/optional HMAC path that unshares or trims the skb would turn it into the seed's exact UAF.
limitation=The 6lowpan and llsec findings depend on a driver delivering non-linear skbs on the 802.15.4 receive path (scatter-gather or fraglist); for the common hardware case where drivers allocate one linear buffer per frame the code is merely fragile, not exploitable.
limitation=Triggering the llsec finding additionally requires a configured 802.15.4 secure network (mac802154_llsec enabled with a key and security level) so that llsec_do_decrypt_auth is reached, and the 6lowpan one requires CONFIG_6LOWPAN plus an ARPHRD_IEEE802154 device with a bound lowpan interface.
limitation=The ranking scan (grep over accessor names with receive-path keyword filtering) does no dataflow analysis, so an accessor-derived pointer invalidated by a helper in another file or by a macro could be missed; conversely the 12-candidate budget means most of the 260 files were classified by pattern heuristics, not full-function reading.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque; line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s01 as supplied, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (confirmed present at pep.c:45-66) was deliberately never reported per branch instruction.
